notes: Minotaurs spawn densely in the Vault of War (first level) of the Stronghold of Security.

Commonly safespotted for Ranged training: the central room south of the spiked chains, the room east of the floor start behind the spiked fences, and the large south-easternmost room behind the spiked fence.
The Stronghold of Security is not on the cannon-prohibited list, but cannon use here is not wiki-documented, so cannonable is left conservatively false.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 296 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Minotaurs is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned by Turael (10-20) and Spria (10-20) in this dataset; no Slayer level required (slayerLevel 1). Their combat-level threshold is around 7.
All defensive bonuses are -21, so any combat style is highly accurate against them; there is no elemental weakness (weakness.element honest null).

Free-to-play task on the first level (Vault of War) of the Stronghold of Security. Uses a tuned copy stronghold-of-security-minotaurs rather than the Ankou-specific base file (whose safespot/konarLockable/cannon flags do not apply).
recommendedMethod: Minotaurs are a free-to-play Turael/Spria task on the first level (Vault of War) of the Stronghold of Security beneath Barbarian Village. Their defensive bonuses are all -21, so any weapon is extremely accurate - bring whatever you train with and a Slayer helmet. Their max hit is only 2, so barely any food is needed; they are ideal early combat and Slayer training.
